g.text: Run many agents for many tenants · 30+ min runs that survive crashes, stay isolated and stay on budget
- Runs are durable: checkpoint each step, lease + heartbeat, resume on any worker
- Fair queue per tenant, concurrency caps
- Untrusted code in a microVM per run, no secrets inside
- Every model call metered; hard cap stops the run
- Tools only through the MCP gateway (authz, audit)
- Traces replay any step for debugging and evals
